question: In which year was the title 'Viceroy’ given to 'Governor-General’ of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1858**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** I**n **August 1858**, the British Parliament enacted the government of India Act, 1858 that terminated the rule of East India company.
 
• The british governor general of India was now given the title of viceroy which meant the representative of Monarch.
 
• The Governor-General of India was given the title of Viceroy for the first time in 1858. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• After the mutiny of 1857 the title of Viceroy was created in 1858.
 
• **Lord Canning** was the first Viceroy of India.The first Governor-General of Bengal was **Warren Hastings** with tenure of office from 1772-1785.
 
• Warren Hastings was an English statesman, the head of the Supreme Council of Bengal. He brought an end to the Dual Government system by enforcing the Regulating Act of 1773.
